supporting_pages.title: Troubleshoot Cloud Run functions \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: For the Shared VPC configuration: Ensure that the service accounts SERVICE PROJECT NUMBER @cloudservices.gserviceaccount.com and service-SERVICE PROJECT NUMBER @gcp-sa-vpcaccess.iam.gserviceaccount.com used by VPC Connector to provision resources in the project are not missing permissions.

In environments where multiple functions are accessing different resources, it's a common practice to use per-function identities with named runtime service accounts rather than the default runtime service account ( PROJECT NUMBER -compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com ).
Serverless VPC Access connector is not ready or does not exist If a Serverless VPC Access connector fails, it might not be using a /28 subnet mask dedicated to the connector as required .
